meta.title: Agent hub
meta.description: DSH dispatches tasks to external agents (AWS Quick, Claude Code, Kiro, ...) through the standalone dsh-hub service; a read-only "Agent" tab of the task board shows tasks, agents and pending requests. Required: DSH_HUB_URL (e.g. https://<hub-host>:7891), DSH_HUB_CONTROLLER_ID and DSH_HUB_TOKEN (issued on the hub with controller add) in <DSH home>/agent-hub/controller.env (not <DSH home>/.env) (DSH_HUB_PROXY optional, direct by default). Workers run scripts/agent_client.py init / register / run.
